about_the_game:
You are a detective on a rogue manhunt through the beautiful country of Italy. Gather clues, interview witnesses and uncover dark secrets to solve the case. Follow your own path to the solution in this 1970's noir crime road-trip.

Puzzles:

In this game, everything has a logical explanation. Gather clues, testimonies, and bulletproof evidence on the Pinboard, then piece it all together to solve the puzzle.

Inventory management:

Carry items from one level to the next, but choose wisely. The trunk is your personal evidence locker, and not everything you find will help crack the case.

Story:

Immerse yourself in an emotional noir mystery, filled with unique characters and moral ambiguity. Unravel a story of crime, where the lines between good and evil blurs and where the truth has a high price. How far are you willing to go to uncover it?

Features:

  • Walk around the individual locations, no Point & Click!

  • Interview bystanders and witnesses.

  • Tetris like inventory management.

  • Gather your thoughts on the pinboard and make logical connections to progress.

  • Search for newly uncovered locations in the directory to unlock them on the map.

  • Travel through Italy in your FIAT-500-I-1972 Kombi*.

*the backseats have been replaced with a trunk.
